# Critical Dirichlet mediator paths for a supplied finite clock program

The complete proof below is accepted as conditional analytic source under root record `9b92b644f7f64dfe6da13f849b36d97cc0bbd8ef47d7485094dd494626f28346`, following separate review `4d112545111a2152dd41970d3607ea6beb6baf34de60bbb2c733fac0a58a9956` and root review `d203bb5d26f0e6dff1607d0cc2bdb0a81c52875eda564ed610f02fe85cbac482`. Root accepted source assembly3f5e450c under CRITICAL_MEDIATOR_ASSEMBLY_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json0eb42090 and review55724844. This publication source and driver require separate exact root acceptance. It carries no retained/audit status or canonical execution authority.

For the full qubit auxiliary operator with one-particle matrix `D=I-A_path/2`, the proof gives the exact Dirichlet inverse, unique vacuum, full many-body gap `1-cos(pi/(N+1))` and full norm MN. It retains every self-energy counterterm and derives a phase-sensitive finite-time comparison from the bare auxiliary vacuum. The original arbitrary H, its scalar, the full elapsed T and arbitrary passive references remain. The logical clock domain is exactly one excitation; forbidden multi-clock response terms are preserved.

With g and the other displayed target parameters fixed, the explicit residual bound permits a sufficient penalty of order N^14. This is additional overhead in supplied finite numerical parameters. It does not bound the inherited waveform/recurrence compiler or arbitrary computable coefficient evaluation, establish optimality, or satisfy a common hardware cap. The later balanced-coupling corollary is separate and is not adopted by this note, irrespective of its own later acceptance status.

The physical ledger retains MN clean auxiliaries, all program ports, the full scalar and covariance, full-space norms and coefficient/timing/preparation/readout costs. Auxiliary path bonds are ordinary nearest neighbor; all clock/data ports are not. For the stated finite data inventory, new range may be as large as M+190 and the maximum auxiliary penalty incidence is2Delta. Positive auxiliaries do not by themselves make the whole generator positive; the optional total reserve is separately charged. Small vacuum leakage does not imply energetic return or catalytic reuse. Physical preparation, control fabrication, precision, stopping, readout, permanent records and reset remain supplied or open.

The actual mathematical roles are distinct. The [Accepted open-path waveform](POSITIVE_OPEN_PATH_CLOCK_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md), exact body `a59c38c7352931da0a5df51c2bca63ddbbe37fd302a18d5a36347235083c967b`, supplies only the conditional waveform estimate with its compact packet, normalization, finite horizon, actual free-clock comparator and fixed-width floor. The [Earlier mediator construction](FINITE_RANGE_CLOCK_DATA_BRIDGE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md), `8831f7bf0398f59780ca965539d9c9be70ec9137add5c3d6d219c895c3fb79b6`, supplies context and the predecessor response/residual route; those critical-path identities are explicitly rederived here. Its current acceptance d43e7e79 is status evidence. Generic inverse, positive-form and Duhamel mechanisms are existing mathematics. Source-family records and procedural ancestry are not additional theorem imports. Actual regular stack parent PR9569 at f51da3b003aa1854e7c1ed4ce8bea753e80aeef1 on physics-loop/toe-local-clock-data-20261014 is bound from root receipts. PARENT_BINDINGS.json separately records the canonical waveform import and rederived predecessor attribution; ancestry supplies no theorem. The graph proposal follows these actual citations and has not been executed.

The archive preserves all39 author files,102 separate-review files, the complete current root evidence folder and actual outer binding/acceptance records, including failures. The author made one N4 exact design with a preserved refinement after initially weak moment/Y discriminators. The separate reviewer made one distinct N4 full-matrix design with a preserved serialization failure and one-line repair; its Bell-state moments do not independently test nonzero signed root/covariance contributions. Neither finite fixture numerically tests two noncommuting Pauli paths; that scope is analytic. Same-model/shared-route exposure is explicit, with no blind or model-diverse claim. Assembly identity checks evaluate zero mathematical predicates and replay no science.

The body is preserved in full and unchanged exactly once. Its original provisional-status paragraphs describe the historical exposure; the current status is stated above and in the exact root records. Byte/line maps and an empty body diff identify the extraction without rewriting history.
